placements.why: No strata exist yet in this repo. This envelope enacts a concrete system-architecture decision (a database engine swap for the analytics pipeline) with a committed timeline — the organizational-strategy category this belongs under is a technical/system-architecture one, and nothing in the supplied (empty) strata covers it, so it is minted standalone as the foundational category future architecture-decision envelopes will nest under.
placements.title: Architecture as a Decision Domain
placements.frame: What structural or technical system decisions are being made, and what do they commit the organization to?

placements.title: Database Migration as an Enacted Commitment
placements.frame: What system migration has been decided, and what timeline is it pinned to?
placements.why: src-1 performs the switch as decided ('we're switching'), src-3 restates the same PostgreSQL→QuantumDB move as a settled bolded header, and src-5 pins a Q3 2026 commitment date to that same decision — together these name a recurring subject (architectural migration decisions and their commitment timelines) rather than a one-time fact, satisfying the narrative grain test. No existing leaf or hub was supplied to hold this theme, so it is minted fresh under the newly-minted Architecture strata.

placements.title: Quantified Performance and Cost as Migration Justification
placements.frame: What measured performance or cost benefit is being marshaled to justify an architectural change?
placements.why: src-2's '10x query performance, lower licensing cost' and src-4's bulleted restatement '10x analytical queries' both offer quantified benefit claims as the rationale for the migration rather than the decision itself — this is a recurring justificatory pattern (performance/cost evidence marshaled for architecture changes) distinct from the enactment leaf, so it is minted as its own leaf rather than folded into the decision leaf or left as a bare fact.
